article.title: How Big Is a "Scoop"?
article.author: Dipp N. Dots
article.featured_img_alt: An ice cream server preparing a scoop
article.content:
Customers often ask how much ice cream goes into one of our scoops. The short answer is: enough to make you smile.

Every serving is hand-scooped, so no two are exactly alike. Our team trains to create a rounded, satisfying portion that sits securely in a cone and leaves room for toppings.

Whether you order one scoop or three, we make each cone with care.
